citation.title: Machine learning-based real-time kinetic profile reconstruction in DIII-D
citation.authors: Shousha R., Seo J., Erickson K., Xing Z., Kim S., Abbate J., Kolemen E.
citation.doi_or_arxiv: 10.1088/1741-4326/ad142f (this paper's DOI, from the PDF header; DOIs in the reference list belong to cited works)

scope_read.pdf_pages: 1-19 (journal pp1-18 = PDF pp2-19), including Figs 1-16, Table 1 and the Appendix
scope_read.limitations: Figure values were read visually. CAKE edge-Ti details rest on the cited Xing 2021 paper, which was not read.

claim_checks.source_finding: The authors describe it as a model with no memory. However, the PCS wrapper reuses the most recent valid data for each input, so stale inputs persist if a diagnostic stops.
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: RTCAKENN maps the latest available magnetic, MSE, TS and CER inputs to CAKE-like profiles with a network the authors describe as memoryless; the surrounding PCS logic holds the last valid input values.
claim_checks.qualification: Holding the last valid input is not temporal modelling. Do not equate it with a causal forecaster.

claim_checks.proposed_claim: Ti accuracy is quantified when CER inputs are dropped.
claim_checks.source_finding: The test regression (Ti R=0.937, sigma=0.068) was run without input dropout. The no-CER hardware test (#914928, which replays #195928 data) shows Ti only qualitatively, with no CAKE comparison. The authors report no clear deterioration pattern and defer a sensitivity analysis. The 15%/13% figures concern ne/Te from the core-edge variant.
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: Input-dropout training lets RTCAKENN return physically plausible profiles without CER, although Ti accuracy in that regime was assessed only qualitatively.
claim_checks.qualification: No quantitative no-CER Ti error is reported.

claim_checks.proposed_claim: In the training target, edge Ti is extrapolated from Te.
claim_checks.source_finding: The authors state that CAKE excludes edge C6+ temperature measurements and extrapolates bulk Ti at the edge using an assumed Ti/Te ratio 'stiffness'. 'Ion' quantities nominally denote C6+.
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: In the CAKE targets used by RTCAKENN, the edge ion temperature is not a direct carbon measurement but is extrapolated through an assumed Ti/Te ratio.
claim_checks.qualification: This describes CAKE's method as reported by these authors. Verify the details in Xing et al. 2021. The extrapolation is via the Ti/Te ratio, not Te alone.

input_target_timing.inputs: Bt and Ip; 15 MSE pitch angles; 8 RT-EFIT (R,Z) boundary points; RT-EFIT p and 1/q; TS ne and Te; CER Ti and rotation (Omega_tor) on a 33-point psi_N grid (PDF p4 Table 1, Fig 1; PDF p6 §3)
input_target_timing.outputs: CAKE-like p, j, 1/q, ne, Te, Ti(C6+) and Vtor on 121 points
input_target_timing.causal_or_offline: Uses same-time or latest-available inputs to reconstruct the current-time profile; it does not forecast an unavailable future report.
input_target_timing.source_diagnostic_as_input: Yes. The CER Ti being reconstructed is itself an input, except when dropped out.
input_target_timing.reported_vs_physical_truth: Targets are offline CAKE reconstructions, which include fitting and edge extrapolation assumptions, not independent physical truth.

validation.split_unit: unknown. The data comprise 696 discharges and 18,959 time points; the test set has 1,334 time slices; there is a validation set used for early stopping. Whether the split is by shot is not stated (PDF p5 §2).
validation.independent_truth: none; CAKE serves as the reference
validation.unknowns: Shot-level or temporal separation; uncertainty intervals; quantitative accuracy for the live discharges beyond the examples in Figs 3-5.

runtime_or_deployment.what_was_measured: PCS execution time of the 10-network ensemble plus overhead: about 13 ms in the initial version and about 7.7 ms in the later version, within a 20 ms CPU cycle. The model ran in DIII-D discharges.
runtime_or_deployment.what_not_established: Use in closed-loop control; diagnostic arrival latency; accuracy relative to CAKE during missing-diagnostic operation.

forbidden_inferences: Assuming a shot-wise or chronological split
Treating CAKE edge Ti as a measured carbon temperature
Claiming priority, or claiming that our task supersedes or beats it
Attributing our study to these authors
competing_or_complementary: Complementary. RTCAKENN reconstructs current profiles using current CER as an input and has a dropout fallback. Our task estimates the current CES report on one chord before it becomes available, using BES/ECEI snapshots and only strictly past CES reports. RTCAKENN could motivate why CES-independent estimates matter, but it is not a baseline on our task.
